query: /horizons refresh fixtures/freshness/index.html from fixtures/freshness/tracker.json. Delivery status only: no regrade and no runtime probes. Today is 2026-10-26. Keep changes local and do not publish.

Keeps the component grades block observed 2026-10-20 with its letters unchanged.

must_not: Change the environments block's observation date, or any block's date to one it was not observed on.
